label: Avatar Info
description: Skeleton loader for avatars and user info. Best for a 48pt avatar circle beside 2 text bars, the second shorter, with no card around them.

label: Card
description: Skeleton loader for a card component. Best for a card that opens with 2 title bars of falling width above a 16:9 media block, with no footer.

label: Text Paragraphs
description: Skeleton loader for text and paragraphs. Best for body copy in 2 paragraphs of full width lines, each closing on a shorter line, with no heading or image.

label: Form
description: Skeleton loader for a form. Best for a stack of 2 label bars over full width input bars, closed by one shorter button bar.

label: Data Table
description: Skeleton loader for a data table. Best for a 3 column header row with a bottom border over 4 body rows, laid out with flex rows.

label: Stats Row
description: Skeleton loader for a dashboard stats row. Best for a row of 3 metric cards, each a small label bar over a tall value bar and a caption line.

label: List With Actions
description: Skeleton loader for a list with actions. Best for a titled list with a header button bar over 3 divided rows of avatar, 2 text lines and a trailing action bar.

label: Card Grid
description: Skeleton loader for a card grid. Best for a card led by a 16:9 media block, then a heading bar and 2 copy lines over a footer with a wide and a square button bar.

label: Profile Page
description: Skeleton loader for a full profile screen. Best for a profile card with an 80px avatar, name lines and 3 stat pairs, above a details card of 4 label and value rows.

label: Chat Messages
description: Skeleton loader for chat messages. Best for incoming bubbles with an avatar and sender bar, one outgoing bubble on the right and a reply field with a square button bar.
